Buisiness Intelligence Project¶

Réalisé par :¶

Ayman Bouchareb

Objectif :¶

The Objectif of this Exercice is to create a model that predicts whether an patient will attend to his rendez-vous,
The (2) sets of data :
    Training Set (train.csv) : this file (set) will be used to train our model 
    Testing Set (test.csv) : this file (set) will be used to benchmark our model

1-2 We write Some helper Functions :¶

In [ ]:
def extract_value_space_of_attribute(dataframe, filter):
    field_space_map = dict([(attribute, set([record[attribute] for (_,record) in dataframe.iterrows()])) for attribute in dataframe if filter(attribute)])
    return pd.DataFrame.from_dict(field_space_map, orient="index")
def transform_label_to_num(df, atts):
    enc = LabelEncoder()
    for att in atts:
        enc.fit(df[att])
        df[att] = enc.transform(df[att])
    return df
def Extract_Outiliers(df, features):   
    return (df[((df[features] != 0) & (df[features] != 1)).sum(axis=1) == 0], df[((df[features] != 1) & (df[features] != 0)).sum(axis=1) != 0])

dataset = pd.concat([train, test], axis=0)
dataset['patient_id'] = dataset['patient_id'].astype('int64')
dataset['schedule_day']= pd.to_datetime(dataset['schedule_day'])
dataset['appointment_day']= pd.to_datetime(dataset['appointment_day'])

1-7 Transforming Data:¶

1-7-1 Proposing New fields :

since it's hard to work with datetime as a field in the model making we propose creating a new field called delay (oppointment_day - schedule_day), and also add a field for the day of the week of the appointment

In [ ]:
dataset['time_gap'] = (dataset['appointment_day'] - dataset['schedule_day']).apply(lambda x : x.total_seconds())
day_of_week = {day:i for i, day in enumerate(["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"])}
dataset['appointment_day'] = dataset['appointment_day'].apply(lambda x : day_of_week[x.strftime("%A")])
dataset['schedule_day'] = dataset['schedule_day'].apply(lambda x : day_of_week[x.strftime("%A")])
dataset['age'] = dataset['age'].apply(lambda x : 1 if x < 18 else 2 if x < 35 else 3 if x < 60 else 4)

for the fields to be dropped we chose the IDs since they are systemic for identifying records but useless when it comes to influencing the "no_show" field

In [ ]:
dataset.drop(columns=['patient_id', 'appointment_id' ], inplace=True)

1-8 Model Building :¶
1-8-1 We split Data into 2 sets :
In [ ]:
## Diviser l’ensemble des données « dataset » en deux sous-ensembles : 80% pour l’apprentissage (training data set) et 20% pour le test (test data set)
training_set, testing_set = train_test_split(dataset, test_size = 0.2)
## Diviser le sous-ensemble d’apprentissage (training data Set) en deux sous-ensembles : 75% pour l’apprentissage et 25% pour la validation.
training_set, validation_set = train_test_split(training_set, test_size = 0.25)
print(f'Train Shape : {train.shape} , Test Shape : {test.shape}')
print(f'testing_set percent : {testing_set.size / dataset.size} , training_set percent : {training_set.size / dataset.size}, , validation_set percent : {validation_set.size / dataset.size}')

Train Shape : (89998, 14) , Test Shape : (20526, 14)
testing_set percent : 0.2 , training_set percent : 0.6, , validation_set percent : 0.2
In [ ]:
features, goal= dataset.columns, 'no_show'
features.drop(goal)
xtrain, ytrain = training_set[features].drop([goal], axis=1), training_set[goal]
xtest, ytest = validation_set[features].drop([goal], axis=1), validation_set[goal]

1-8-2 Training the Models :
In [ ]:
kfold = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=10)
random_state = 2
classifiers = [ ("KNeighborsClassifier", KNeighborsClassifier()), 
                ("DecisionTreeClassifier", DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=random_state))]

cv_results = []
for _, classifier in classifiers :
    cv_results.append(cross_val_score(classifier, xtrain, y = ytrain, scoring = "accuracy", cv = kfold, n_jobs=4))
cv_means = []
cv_std = []
for cv_result in cv_results:
    cv_means.append(cv_result.mean())
    cv_std.append(cv_result.std())

cv_res = pd.DataFrame({"CrossValMeans":cv_means,"CrossValerrors": cv_std,"Algorithm":["KNeighbors", "DecisionTree"]})

parameters = {
    "KNeighborsClassifier" :  {
      'n_neighbors': [1,30],

In [ ]:
fune_tuned_classifiers = {}
for name, classifier in classifiers :
    gridsrch = GridSearchCV(classifier,param_grid = parameters[name], cv=kfold, scoring="accuracy", n_jobs=4, verbose = 1)
    gridsrch.fit(xtrain,ytrain)
    fune_tuned_classifiers[name] = gridsrch.best_estimator_

Fitting 10 folds for each of 36 candidates, totalling 360 fits
Fitting 10 folds for each of 300 candidates, totalling 3000 fits

1-8-4 We generate multiple training/validation sets for each model :
In [ ]:
gen_samples =  lambda n : [training_set.sample(frac = 0.01) for _ in range(n)]

1-8-5 We Test fit the models with RandomizedSearchCV or GridSearch algorithms :
In [ ]:
samples, results = gen_samples(50), {}
for name in fune_tuned_classifiers:
    classifier = fune_tuned_classifiers[name]
    acc_datas = []
    for sample in samples:
        x, y = sample[features].drop([goal], axis=1), sample[goal]
        classifier.fit(x, y)
        predictions = classifier.predict(xtest)
        acc_datas.append(([accuracy_score(ytest,predictions), classifier]))
    results[name] = acc_datas
In [ ]:
